creaturechat.config.help:
Commands:
 /creaturechat key set <value> [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat url set <value> [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat model set <value> [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat timeout set <value> [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat story set <value> [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat story clear [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat story show
 /creaturechat whitelist <entity|all|clear> [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat blacklist <entity|all|clear> [--config default|server]
 /creaturechat chatbubble set <on|off> [--config default|server]
Optional: Append [--config default | server] to any command to specify configuration scope.

Security: Level 4 permission required.
